findings.title: CORS misconfiguration (wildcard origin)
findings.description: PentestGPT (agentic) confirmou cors misconfiguration (wildcard origin) durante execucao autonoma contra http://localhost:3000.
findings.evidence: Fetched root page of http://localhost:3000. Identified application as OWASP Juice Shop (Angular SPA) via title/comments. Response headers leak a route (X-Recruiting: /#/jobs) and disclose CORS misconfig (Access-Allow-Origin: *) and security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options). Page references static assets/scripts: main.js, polyfills.js, scripts.js, styles.css, and chunk-*.js bundle files, plus assets/public/favicon_js.ico. Probed RES
